rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with a good-quality blastocyst and acknowledges image limitations, but it overstates confidence in visible ICM/TE detail from this single somewhat unclear frame and introduces stage-label ambiguity around 3AA vs expanded blastocyst.
Integrates age, FSH, BMI, endometrium, cycle history, smoking, and semen data well with embryo prognosis; only minor overinterpretation of the male-factor label without additional data.

Reasoning is structured and mostly logical, with probability estimate tied to morphology and patient factors; minor inconsistency arises from calling it top-tier while also questioning the stage designation.

Recommendations are broadly consistent with IVF practice and Gardner/SET principles, including caution on smoking and not overreacting to one failed transfer; slight grading terminology confusion prevents a perfect score.
Provides clear, practical next steps for transfer management, lifestyle modification, and contingency planning for future cycles with appropriate nuance.
